title: Intravital Microscopy-Guided Live-Cell Isolation for Spatially Resolved Transcriptional Analysis of Leukemia-Immune Interactions​.
snippet: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) progresses within a spatially heterogeneous bone marrow microenvironment, where local leukemic burden may influence interactions between AML cells and surrounding hematopoietic and immune cells.
